Test Description: This test performs PCIe device enumeration for both PCIE0 and PCIE1 instances. It initializes link training, programs cache coherency control registers, polls SII status registers to confirm link-up, reads the Vendor ID, enables memory and bus master access, programs memory base addresses, configures system-level registers, then enumerates BAR registers on both PCIe slave ports by writing all-ones to determine BAR sizes, reading back, and programming final BAR values. Finally it polls a synchronization register for test completion.
Test Objective: Verify PCIe device enumeration flow including link training, cache coherency configuration, SII link-up polling, Vendor ID read, command register enable, memory base programming, BAR sizing and assignment on both PCIe controller instances.
Test Steps:
1. Write 0x0 to system synchronization register 0xE6004100.
2. Initiate PCIe link training for the configured dual-mode (DM0/DM1) in x4 width.
3. Program COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF for PCIE0 by read-modify-write to set cache mode bits [14:11] and [6:3] to 0xF, then cache value bits [30:27] and [22:19] to 0xF.
4. Repeat for PCIE1.
5. Wait 20 cycles, consolidate all four cache fields.
6. Poll SII0 at offset 0xC0 until link-up pattern 0xD1.
7. Poll SII1 at offset 0xC0 until link-up pattern 0xD1.
8. Read TYPE1_DEV_ID_VEND_ID_REG from PCIe slave port 0.
9. Write 0x7 to TYPE1_STATUS_COMMAND_REG.
10. Execute memory base programming.
11. Write 0x1 to six system-level control registers.
12. Disable cache by clearing value fields.
13. BAR sizing and assignment on both slave ports.
14. Poll synchronization register for 0x12345678.
Expected Results: Link training completes. SII0 and SII1 report link-up 0xD1. Vendor ID read correctly. BAR sizing returns valid masks. Final BAR values verified. Synchronization register reaches 0x12345678.
Notes: System-level synchronization register. Written to 0x0 at start and polled for 0x12345678 at end.

Test Description: This test verifies PCIe DMA write and read-back operations across all four DMA channels (0-3) on both PCIE0 and PCIE1 controller instances with interrupt-driven completion.
Test Objective: Verify PCIe DMA write and read-back data transfer across all four DMA channels on both PCIE controller instances.
Test Steps:
1. Clear synchronization register.
2. Link training.
3. Poll SII for link-up.
4. Read Vendor ID.
5. Write 0x7 to command register.
6. BAR and memory base programming.
7. Poll synchronization register for 0x12345678.
8. Preload source memory with 0xC0DEBEED and 0xF00DDEAF.
9. Enable GIC interrupts.
10. Unmask DMA write and read interrupts.
11-14. Program and trigger DMA write channels 0-3 via doorbell.
15-18. Program and trigger DMA read channels 0-3 via doorbell.
19. Handle interrupts in Default_IRQHandler.
20. Repeat for PCIE1.
21. Call finish(0).
Expected Results: All DMA write and read-back transfers complete successfully with interrupt assertion on both PCIE0 and PCIE1.
Notes: System-level synchronization register.
